achievements: Supplies a reproducible competitor table that functions as direct counterevidence.

contradictions.statement: Printed verdict conflicts with the computed ranking; the computed ranking is retained as the negative result.

legacy_conclusion: The prose claimed BCC uniqueness, but the executable ranking places BCC ninth and lamellar first.
legacy_purpose: Rank ten single-shell crystallographic competitors and argue for BCC uniqueness.
negative_findings: Fresh execution refutes the note's own BCC-uniqueness interpretation.
next_actions: Use as a mandatory negative control in every T-055 structural-selection batch.
no_overclaim: Neither this refutation nor its finite competitor list proves which structure is the physical vacuum.
title: Crystallographic competitor ranking refutation
